versions.changelog: Ensure all references use cside (no slash)
Fix: updated all references from c/side to cside in SKILL.md

- Initial release of cside-site-scanner, a comprehensive website scanning tool for security, privacy, and compliance auditing.
- Detects third-party scripts, tag manager injections, security headers, PCI DSS 4.0 risks, trackers, and fingerprinting techniques.
- Grades sites A–F based on factors like CSP, SRI, HSTS, third-party scripts, fingerprinting, and cookie security.
- Generates detailed reports with risk flags, domain breakdowns, security header states, and PCI/Privacy/Fingerprinting insights.
- Emphasizes scan limitations and positions c/side for continuous, runtime-focused monitoring.
